findings.finding: REL-0244 applies repealed_under to a compound subject containing conscription, the forced loan and Law of Hostages. The source identifies repeal of the latter two; it continues to discuss conscription as an operative cause of banditry. The whole composite cannot safely serve as an unqualified repeal antecedent.
findings.action: Scope the edge to the two repealed measures, or use separately justified component nodes. Do not infer wholesale repeal of conscription.

findings.finding: The 1802 date is a reasonable internal-chronology inference, but the record silently resolves an explicit source inconsistency. Legacy UNC-E6DC0EA51B05 records both alternatives.
findings.action: Preserve the discrepancy and mark the inferred date before any external correction.

findings.finding: Some priority changes are changes in where analytical weight is placed, not differences in substantive treatment. Separate legacy illustrations can overlap their umbrella requirement; some native reductions of priority affect explicit limits of the central equality argument.
findings.action: Use a whole-book priority rationale and declared overlap rules; do not use label count, frequency, or page count as a quota.

findings.finding: Consolidation retains broad treatment but weakens explicit access to free-coloured citizenship, geographically different restoration outcomes, and aggregate human cost.
findings.action: Restore the demonstrated access and qualification inside coherent units before considering additional standalone requirements.

findings.finding: The inspected native tasks all use a general argument-and-qualification template. They are answerable but do not independently test distinctive contrasts. Some legacy questions supply those contrasts; other legacy questions are equally generic. Task count and fallback flags do not establish editorial quality.
findings.action: Independently write or adjudicate source-answerable tasks for constitutional accommodation, colonial outcome differences, and the human-cost verdict; verify all linked subject IDs.

recommendation: Create a versioned successor through source-only reconciliation and a separate fresh-context review. Use native organizing units where this comparison demonstrates retained meaning, incorporate justified legacy access and qualifications, and explicitly adjudicate every unreviewed item. No wholesale union, final base approval, freeze alteration, successor registration or audit transfer is authorized by this report.
